blocks.text: David's transport of the ark to Jerusalem represents a transformative moment in establishing the city as Israel's religious center. The narrative unfolds in two movements: an initial attempt that ends in tragedy when Uzzah dies attempting to steady the ark as oxen stumble, and a second, successful journey after the ark rests three months in Obed-edom's household, where God brings blessing. This arc demonstrates both the sacred significance of the ark to David's vision and the complex protocols governing approach to this object of divine presence.
